results.question: How many people are in my organisation?
results.answer: Your organisation has 1470 people.
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees

results.question: What is the overall attrition rate?
results.answer: The overall attrition rate is 16.1 %. The calculation is based on a group of 1470 employees.
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN attrition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS attrition_rate_pct FROM employees

results.question: What is the attrition rate by department?
results.answer: Sales has an attrition rate of 20.6 percent with a headcount of 446. Human Resources has an attrition rate of 19.0 percent with a headcount of 63. Research & Development has an attrition rate of 13.8 percent with a headcount of 961.
results.sql: SELECT department, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN attrition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS attrition_rate_pct, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees GROUP BY department

results.question: What is the average monthly income by job role?
results.answer: Managers have an average monthly income of 17130.3 (headcount 54). Research Directors average 15992.9 (headcount 79) and Manufacturing Directors 7295.1 (headcount 145). Research Scientists earn 3240.0 (headcount 292) and Laboratory Technicians 3237.2 (headcount 259). Healthcare Representatives average 7528.8 (headcount 131).
results.sql:
SELECT job_role,
       ROUND(AVG(monthly_income), 1) AS avg_monthly_income,
       COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM employees
GROUP BY job_role

results.question: What share of people work overtime in each department?
results.answer: In Sales, 28.7% of the 446 employees work overtime. In Human Resources, 27.0% of the 63 employees work overtime. In Research & Development, 28.2% of the 961 employees work overtime.
results.sql:
SELECT department,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN over_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS overtime_share_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM employees
GROUP BY department

results.question: What is the average number of years at the company in each department?

results.question: What is the average job satisfaction by job role?
results.answer: Sales Representative has an average job satisfaction of 2.7 with 83 employees. Sales Executive averages 2.8 across 326 employees. Manager also averages 2.8 with 37 employees.

results.question: Is attrition higher for people who work overtime?
results.answer: People who work overtime have an attrition rate of 30.5% (headcount 416). Those who do not work overtime have an attrition rate of 10.4% (headcount 1054). The overtime group’s attrition rate is higher.
results.sql:
SELECT over_time,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN attrition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS attrition_rate_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM employees
GROUP BY over_time
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

results.question: How does the attrition rate vary with business travel?
results.answer: Employees who do not travel have an attrition rate of 8.0 % (headcount 150). Those who travel rarely see a rate of 15.0 % (headcount 1,043). Employees who travel frequently have the highest rate at 24.9 % (headcount 277). The attrition rate increases as business travel frequency rises.
results.sql:

       ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN attrition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS attrition_rate_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM employees
GROUP BY business_travel
